name: Silence
summary: Ritual. A silent 20-ft Sphere: those inside are Deafened and immune to Thunder; no Verbal spells there.
text: For the duration, no sound can be created inside or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures entirely inside it have the Deafened condition. Casting a spell with a Verbal component is impossible there.
